nodes.label: Jenkinsfile deploy-time backup hook
nodes.rationale: Deploy-time backup alone is insufficient since it only runs when someone deploys; wired into Jenkinsfile so every deploy is preceded by a backup.

nodes.label: Nightly cron backup schedule
nodes.rationale: Deploy-time backups alone are not enough because data accumulated since the last deploy would otherwise be unprotected; a nightly cron entry must still be added manually on the Jenkins host.

nodes.label: Backup restore drill practice
nodes.rationale: An untested backup is a guess; running a scratch restore and timing it establishes confidence and a known recovery time before a real incident.

nodes.label: Server-side Google Places / Maps API key config
nodes.norm_label: server-side google places / maps api key config
nodes.rationale: The server-side Places API key must not be the same key the browser uses for maps: it is called only from the server, so it is locked to the server IP and to the Places API. Left blank, address autocomplete simply returns no suggestions and addresses stay manually typeable. The separate browser maps-api-key is referrer-restricted to Maps JavaScript API only, since a browser key cannot be kept secret.

nodes.label: Hikari connection pool keepalive fix
nodes.rationale: Without liveness checking Hikari handed out dead idle connections after the DB (or something between) dropped them, causing every request to fail with 'Connection is not available' until the backend was restarted. keepalive-time pings idle connections, max-lifetime retires them under the typical 30-min server idle timeout, and validation-timeout bounds the liveness check; idle-timeout is not set because the pool runs at fixed size.

nodes.label: Multipart upload size limit for site walkthrough videos
nodes.norm_label: multipart upload size limit for site walkthrough videos
nodes.rationale: Raised from 50MB to 512MB to allow site walkthrough videos up to seven minutes. This is a container-level ceiling enforced by Spring before any controller runs, so it cannot be set per endpoint; the actual per-endpoint 50MB cap is enforced in code by FileService, with only the walkthrough endpoint opting into a larger limit. file-size-threshold of 1MB makes Spring stream large uploads to a temp file instead of holding them in heap memory.

nodes.label: Flutter CI analyze-and-test pipeline
nodes.rationale: CI-001: the repo previously had no CI, so nothing checked a change before merge. Build/release steps are deliberately excluded since signing keys and store credentials belong to the release pipeline owner, not this file. The analyze step gates only on error/warning-level lints because ~316 pre-existing info-level lints (mostly deprecated withOpacity and use_build_context_synchronously) would fail every build from day one; --no-fatal-infos alone is insufficient since flutter analyze still exits non-zero on any issue, so severity is checked explicitly via grep.

nodes.label: video_player dependency (site walkthrough playback)
nodes.rationale: Added specifically for playing back site walkthrough videos; image_picker already handles recording and choosing the video, so video_player is only needed for in-app playback.
